column1: # Touch layout for Rhythm Heaven Groove's rhythm pad (DmRhythmPad.m).
#   left  = the key the left half of the screen sends in that minigame (none, B, Left, Right, Down, Up)
#   extra = optional comma-separated directions (Left, Right, Down, Up), drawn as small glass keys at the bottom left
#   "*"   = the default row for any scene not listed (the A-only games use none; the whole picture sends A)
# The scene name is the folder under graph/scene/; Beatspell uses graph/beatspell/.
# The runtime file Documents/touch_layouts.tsv replaces this table on the device, so more rows can be filled without rebuilding.

column4: Brolly Good Show (A opens the umbrella, Down closes it)
High-Five Fever (A and B for the two hands)
Hop N Slide (A hops, Down slides)
Hop Stop N Roll (A hops, Down rolls)
Remixes: the left half is B, the small keys carry the directions
